subject.title: feat(cli): add experimental Antigravity agy backend

question: After the prompt-transport defect is fixed, should OpenClaw bundle this narrow text-only preview provider or require it to ship as an external plugin while broader Antigravity agentic support remains open?
rationale: Existing plugin seams already support the integration, the vendor contract is preview and fast-moving, and this PR does not provide the broader migration requested by the canonical issue; first-party ownership therefore cannot be inferred from technical correctness alone.

options.title: External text plugin
options.body: Publish the repaired text-only integration through the existing plugin ecosystem and keep broader agentic support separately tracked.

options.title: Bundle narrow preview
options.body: Accept first-party ownership only after transport repair, exact-head proof, and explicit provider-area sponsorship.

recommendation.title: External text plugin
recommendation.body: Publish the repaired text-only integration through the existing plugin ecosystem and keep broader agentic support separately tracked.

likelyOwner.reason: The live assignee is best positioned to route the immediate product decision, with `steipete` and `vincentkoc` providing the strongest code-history context.
